package demo;
import javax.baja.sys.*;
@NiagaraType
public final class U1 extends BComponent {
  @NiagaraProperty(name = "defrostInterval", defaultValue = "BRelTime.makeHours(4)")
  private BRelTime defrostInterval;
  @NiagaraProperty(name = "defrostDuration", defaultValue = "BRelTime.make(1800000L)")
  private BRelTime defrostDuration;
}
